PHYSICS CHECK — Driving variable is shell-side flow velocity (u_s). Tube-flow-induced vibration (FIV) damage accumulates when u_s enters the Strouhal band u_s ≈ f_vortex · S / St (where f_vortex is the tube-row natural frequency and St is the Strouhal number ~0.2). Magnitude verification: at 10 bar, shell-side u_s ~ 1–3 m/s for typical heat exchanger velocities; if tube natural frequency f_n ~ 50–200 Hz and tube pitch S ~ 25 mm, the resonance velocity band is u_s = f_n·S/St = (50–200)·0.025/0.2 = 6.25–25 m/s. The operating range is BELOW this band; however, transient flow excursions or fouling-driven velocity redistribution can push local u_s into the band. DIRECTION-OF-EFFECT: driving variable = shell-side local velocity; the mechanism moves it DOWN by enforcing a velocity ceiling derived from existing ΔP and T_data; this reduces the FIV damage integral over the duty cycle.

2. **Flow Controller Setpoint Adjustment** (a: existing control system, b: standard practice uses flow control; c: no new sensors)
   - Action: When computed u_s approaches u_s_max, trim shell-side flow rate down via existing control valve (stated: "existing control valve on the shell-side inlet/out"). This is a parameter/procedure change on the existing actuation path.
3. **Fouling Monitoring via ΔP Trend** (a: data analysis routine, b: standard practice already monitors ΔP for fouling; c: no new instrumentation)

Installability: zero (existing control system). Operability: automatic (firmware logic). Maintenance: zero (no new components). Cost class: SAME (software only, no BOM). Operational loss: zero (no throughput reduction unless u_s exceeds ceiling, which is a failure precursor, not a loss). The burden is lower because no new sensors.

If u_s entered the band, back-calculate time-to-leak (TTL) via Palmgren-Miner rule; if TTL < 30 days at any point, the predictor must have flagged it. Pass threshold: TTL predicted ≥ 30 days before actual leak. Kill criterion: If the predictor fails to flag any historical excursion within 30 days of leak, the mechanism is invalid.

CONSTRAINT BIND — Primary stated indicator: shell-side pressure drop (ΔP). Why: ΔP is the direct proxy for flow velocity and fouling state; its trend defines the operating window. Secondary: temperature (supplementing ΔP for property calculation). No tube accelerometer used, per constraint.
